title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-12-31
lineage: aud reel master>7" reel @ 7.5 ips technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96>hd>cd wave>adobe 16/44>flac

ai_review.summary: Stunning 1970 audience tape with crisp sound and an outstanding Cold Rain and Snow, though a few cuts interrupt the flow.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the surprisingly high‑fidelity audience recording for a 1970 show, calling it “sweet” and even “STUNNING AUD”.  The band is described as ripping it up, with Cold Rain and Snow singled out as a highlight, while an audible cut in Easy Wind is the only notable blemish.

ai_rating.rationale: Overall strong praise for both performance and recording (average 4‑star rating, with one 5‑star review) but limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear for a 1970 audience source; sweet setup yields crisp detail.  Some cuts are present, most noticeably in Easy Wind.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic performance that keeps momentum despite the occasional gap; overall flow is strong and enjoyable.
